fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the rogue cell via RAN’s E-UTRAN cell blacklist with timer-based re-evaluation every 15 minutes.
Enforce strict NAS security mode commands (SMC) with counter for failed attempts, triggering UE ejection.
Deploy MME-level NAS message validation rules to reject unencrypted or malformed EMM messages.
Implement NAS message integrity checks with KPI for failed integrity checks, auto-blocking UEs.
Update MME’s authentication vectors cache with a 1-hour refresh counter to prevent replay attacks.
Enable RAN’s NAS security algorithm selection to enforce only AES-128 for encryption.
Configure MME to reject NAS messages with invalid NAS message type identifiers (e.g., 126).
Set RRC connection re-establishment counters to 3 failed attempts before UE blacklisting.
Deploy core-level NAS trace analysis with anomaly detection rules for repeated EMM_REGISTRATION_REJECTED.
Monitor NAS signaling load per cell with KPI thresholds, flagging spikes in EMM messages.
